patched_queries: strictly greater than first-newline position p
secondary_attention_rule: At layer 8 replay baseline P; at all other layers allow endogenous recipient routing. Layer 8 P would naturally equal baseline because all earlier layers are unmodified.

conditions.identity: Recipient p V at recipient p, exact replay integrity control.
conditions.matched: Independent paraphrase, same fact label, donor p V at recipient p.
conditions.mismatched: Same paraphrase template, opposite label, donor p V at recipient p.
conditions.irrelevant: Unrelated room/window fact, donor p V at recipient p.
conditions.source0: Unrelated-content donor source0 V at recipient source0; same initial token 510. Exact causal negative control, not a test of p.
conditions.p_from_source0: Recipient source0 V at recipient p. Preserves p routing but removes later-fact information from the supplied p value.
conditions.ordinary_normmatched: Opposite-label paraphrase fact-token V at recipient fact-token position p-2, only for queries>p; perturbation scaled per query so aggregate post-W_O norm matches the mismatched newline-p perturbation. Known-carrier positive control, not an exact distance match.

worlds.postboundary_mask0: Source0 excluded only at queries>p, layers2..15. Prefix<=p remains native. P replay uses this world's baseline, not unmasked native P.

primary_measure: Per recipient log P(correct)-log P(foil); primary donor-label contrast is matched margin minus mismatched margin. Average the two reciprocal recipients within each pair before aggregating pairs.
strong_transfer_definition: Baseline and matched-donor correct-minus-foil margins positive, mismatched-donor margin negative, in both reciprocal label directions. Report each world separately.
baseline_gate: Both reciprocal baseline margins >0 in that world. Retain every example and report all-example results plus separately labeled baseline-qualified subset. Never exclude or tune from donor effects.
whole_input_oracle: The opposite recipient input differs in exactly one pre-newline fact token. Its baseline supplies the attainable opposite-label preference benchmark, expressed in the original recipient's correct/foil orientation.
null_controls: Identity and source0 cross-content interventions must preserve prediction margin within1e-4 and prefix per-layer SHA256 exactly. Manual observed-target logit must agree with streamed full-vocabulary target_logit within1e-3.
negative_result_limit: No transfer does not show that p lacks payload: direct fact access may dominate, donor signal may be weak, or fixed routing may remove necessary decoding paths.
semantic_claim_limit: This is a one-token fact-information assay, not proof of abstract semantics. Context and lexical identity remain correlated.
source_role_limit: Short controlled prompts do not establish that their first newline is an attention sink or replicate long native corpus routing.
